question: What security and ownership boundary should the Dashboard browser preview use before implementation?
rationale: The panel would expose sensitive browser state and may be implemented as core Control UI or plugin-contributed UI; automation cannot safely choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Browser plugin tab, read-only first
options.body: Add a browser-plugin-owned or approved bundled tab for tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs, while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credentials, and submits.

options.title: Core first-party admin page
options.body: Implement a first-party Control UI browser page if maintainers want the preview treated as core operator infrastructure rather than plugin UI.

options.title: Defer behind generic entry points
options.body: Wait for the generic plugin UI entry-point contract to settle before building the browser-specific panel.

recommendation.title: Browser plugin tab, read-only first
recommendation.body: Add a browser-plugin-owned or approved bundled tab for tabs, URL/title, screenshots, and logs, while requiring explicit user steps for navigation, clicks, credentials, and submits.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from browser runtime, Control UI routing, and the existing issue discussion.
